name: XRP VolFavorite, early checkpoints
description: xrp-volfav with checkpoints only at 480/360/300/240 s before close (threshold refit on those horizons).
hypothesis: Late (<=180 s) buyers are informed (xrp-tie: late takers win 73-86%), so late asks are adverse; the volfav mispricing is retail overpaying earlier in the window. DEV-INFORMED: a research screen (agent run 20261021-0057-1) showed XRP 60-180 s checkpoints at -0.2..-1.5c and 240-480 s at +1.4..+2.2c. Wrong if full walk-forward is not better than xrp-volfav's +1.33c, or lockbox loses. Family lockbox evidence counts with xrp-volfav.
